purpose: Three hypothetical scenario storyboards; existing equipment only; no future product

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: illustration layer for an industrial design research storyboard printed A3 landscape. Generate ONE high-resolution wide image (roughly 3840 by 2160, aspect 16:9) with EXACTLY SIX separate storyboard cells in a precise 3-column by 2-row equal grid. The cells have equal widths and heights, slim white gutters, white page background. In EACH cell reserve the BOTTOM 26 percent completely blank pure white for later professionally typeset captions. All drawing must fit in the top 74 percent of its cell. No letters, numbers, text, titles, arrows, labels, icons or watermark anywhere. Clear colored editorial hand-drawn illustration with clean dark navy outlines, gentle teal, terracotta and ochre accents, warm light grey room, minimal watercolor texture. Not photography. Neutral existing home exercise equipment ONLY. Never depict a new exercise platform, modular product, special cabinet, fitness machine or invented mechanism. Use a normal rolled yoga mat, two ordinary dumbbells, an open basket or plain ordinary low shelf as existing room furniture. Consistent small apartment living room across all six cells, ordinary sofa against back wall, light coffee table movable aside, window, door, enough white space to understand the floor. Show entire bodies including hands and feet, believable anatomy and action, no cut-off limbs.
Same protagonist in all cells: young adult man around 26, short dark hair, teal T-shirt, charcoal sport trousers, barefoot. Reading order left to right, top row then bottom.
Cell1: after work, man at room entrance looking at coffee table occupying the free floor, backpack put beside entrance. Rolled mat and equipment still stored. His motivation is a short home activity, not a workout instruction.
Cell2: man moves ONLY the lightweight coffee table to the wall, clearing an unobstructed floor zone and a route to the door. Sofa stays fixed.
Cell3: man kneels beside a normal mat, unrolls it onto the floor, takes ordinary dumbbells out of a low open basket and sets them carefully outside the mat and outside the walking path.
Cell4: man demonstrates a controlled modified push-up, hands and knees clearly contact the normal mat on the actual floor, torso aligned, no unsupported floating limbs. Dumbbells remain outside his movement area.
Cell5: same man stands on floor beside mat, slight knee bend, hips hinged back, holding two modest dumbbells close to his shins, normal Romanian deadlift demonstration pose, not deep rounded spinal flexion. There is empty space around his torso and elbows. No numbers or prescribed load.
Cell6: man has returned dumbbells to ordinary basket and rolls mat after use; coffee table is back near sofa, visible clear route, relaxed ordinary room. Show actual cleaning-up action, not a posed portrait.
Constraints: ONLY illustrations of a hypothetical user scenario. No promises of safety, no medical symbols. Six distinct actions, same person and room. Ensure all reserved caption bands are empty and exactly aligned at each cell bottom.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: illustration layer for A3 landscape research storyboard about a couple sharing home exercise equipment. ONE high-resolution wide image roughly 3840x2160, 16:9. EXACTLY SIX equal rectangular cells arranged in a 3-column by 2-row grid with slim white gutters. Each cell: illustration in TOP 74 percent only, BOTTOM 26 percent pure blank white reserved for captions. NO text, letters, numbers, arrows, symbols, labels or watermarks anywhere. Clear colored editorial line illustration, dark navy contours, warm pale grey apartment, teal/terracotta/ochre accents, subtle watercolor. Same consistent ordinary small living room with sofa at back, light coffee table moved aside, door at left and existing low open shelf and basket at back. No novel product, panel, special cabinet, modular platform or invention. Only one normal exercise mat, two ordinary dumbbells, a stable everyday chair. Keep bodies complete with clear grounded contact and believable anatomy.
Same couple in every cell: young man short dark hair teal shirt charcoal trousers; young woman dark brown tied hair rust/coral shirt navy leggings. No age labels.
Cell1: both stand in living room discussing a shared activity; coffee table occupies central floor, equipment stored, indicate their attention through natural gestures not speech bubbles.
Cell2: both prepare room: woman moves lightweight table aside, man unrolls ordinary mat at LEFT side, ordinary dumbbells kept by RIGHT side, central doorway passage remains clear. Show two separate floor areas, no painted graphic zones.
Cell3: simultaneous-use candidate: man doing modified push-up hands and knees grounded on LEFT mat; woman standing on RIGHT area doing a controlled dumbbell bent-over row with hips hinged and elbows near torso. They are visibly separate with a clear gap, no touching or intersecting limbs; do not exaggerate room size. This is a qualitative illustration, no distances.
Cell4: both have PAUSED their exercise to notice a conflict: woman stands still near the basket and man's natural route back from mat would pass the same narrow area. They look at the shared access area and gesture calmly. Nobody lifts weights while another crosses the working path. No red crosses, arrows or hazard icons.
Cell5: sequential-use candidate in same room: woman uses the now free mat for a modified push-up, man waits seated on a normal stable chair positioned outside her movement zone; dumbbells returned to shelf. They share one active spot at different moments, not sitting on equipment.
Cell6: both clean up together: man returns dumbbells to ordinary open shelf, woman rolls mat; table returns near sofa, room becomes ordinary living space with clear passage.
No workout dose, no invented equipment. Show all six distinct scenes and exact blank caption bands.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: six-frame A3 research storyboard of a family using existing exercise items sequentially in an ordinary apartment. ONE high-resolution image roughly 3840x2160, 16:9. EXACTLY SIX equal cells in a 3-column by 2-row grid. TOP 74 percent of each cell contains illustration, BOTTOM 26 percent is completely pure white blank for captions, with slim white gutters. No text, letters, numbers, arrows, icons, labels or watermarks. Clean colored editorial drawing with navy outlines, warm pale grey interior, teal, coral and mustard color accents, subtle watercolor texture. Same modest small apartment living room across all panels: fixed sofa against wall, door, window, lightweight coffee table, ordinary low shelf or basket, rolled mat, soft small ball and one normal sturdy non-wheeled chair. NO future product, special cabinet, invented platform, modular system or fitness machine. No floor level changes or floating supports. Full human bodies, clear hand/foot/seat contacts, normal anatomy, do not stereotype older adults as frail.
Same FOUR family members in all cells: mother about35 teal shirt charcoal trousers, school-age child roughly10 coral shirt blue shorts, grandmother about68 short grey hair mustard cardigan navy trousers, grandfather about72 grey hair blue polo grey trousers. Use age only to set visual identities, no text age labels. Mother is a participating organizer/supporting partner, not a clinician. Grandparents active ordinary adults, no canes or disability added.
Cell1: four family members in usual living room agree who will use the space first; everyday room with coffee table in center, child holding soft ball, grandparents and mother naturally conversing with gestures.
Cell2: mother moves lightweight table aside and puts ordinary chair with all four legs grounded in a clear floor position; child unrolls normal mat with her nearby. Grandparents wait on sofa away from preparation route. Heavy adult accessories remain stored apart from child's play objects.
Cell3: child kneels on normal mat passing a soft light ball to mother sitting or kneeling nearby, both within comfortable arm reach; grandparents watch from sofa outside play zone. Depict simple exchange without jump, extreme stretch or airborne dangerous pose.
Cell4: grandmother sits upright on sturdy normal chair with both feet flat on actual floor, gently turning upper torso to one side with arms loosely crossed; mother and child wait off the active area, grandfather on sofa. No extreme twisting or touching pressure by another person.
Cell5: grandfather stands behind same chair, both hands clearly holding its solid backrest, heels slightly raised and toes grounded on actual floor. Grandmother now on sofa, mother and child wait aside. Chair is a support, not exercise platform. No unstable cushion.
Cell6: mother and child put the soft ball in ordinary basket and roll the mat; grandparents are seated comfortably in usual living room, coffee table restored. Show real shared clean-up and an unobstructed route to door.
Constraints: successive users at different moments, never all four doing exercises together. No medical claims, doses or prescribed duration. Keep every character recognizable and every reserved caption band blank.
